metadata.title: Multi-scale Neural Networks for Retinal Blood Vessels Segmentation

extraction_notes.note: Network architecture and augmentation are described in prose and figures, not pseudocode; extracted as unmarked algorithms with judgment-based step boundaries.

Per-metric experimental comparisons (individual percentages per dataset), dataset descriptions, the Adam training setup and the robustness discussion were not extracted; only the per-section summary sentences became numerical claims. Result tables in the appendix carry no math.
claim or remark: empirical benchmark statements, kept as numerically supported claims since the abstract announces them as contributions.

metadata.extraction_comment: Applied deep-learning paper with only two displayed equations, both imported (atrous convolution, ACE).
